C0933.title: CCTV Exposes Anti-Collection Scam: High Service Fees and Resale of Borrower Information
C0933.summary: In April 2022, CCTV Finance exposed the tactics of 'anti-collection' organizations: they disguise themselves as debt restructuring firms or law offices, charging debtors 6%-10% of total debt as service fees, or 30%-50% for fully delegated services.
